beamsplit_toggle.title: Toggle split-screen
beamsplit_toggle.desc: Turn BeamSplit local split-screen on or off. Player count follows the number of connected gamepads.

beamsplit_layout.title: Cycle split-screen layout
beamsplit_layout.desc: Step through the rows / columns / grid tile layouts.

beamsplit_hud.title: Toggle split-screen HUD
beamsplit_hud.desc: Show or hide the per-player gauge cluster in each tile.

beamsplit_audio.title: Cycle split-screen audio focus
beamsplit_audio.desc: Move the single audio listener between the midpoint of all players and each individual player.

beamsplit_menu.title: Split-screen menu
beamsplit_menu.desc: Open BeamSplit's menu during a split, or BeamNG's normal pause menu after End Session.

beamsplit_next_car.title: Next car / picker down (split-screen)
beamsplit_next_car.desc: Move this player to the next free car, or scroll their vehicle picker when it is open.

beamsplit_prev_car.title: Previous car / picker up (split-screen)
beamsplit_prev_car.desc: Move this player to the previous free car, or scroll their vehicle picker when it is open.

beamsplit_nav_left.title: Recover car / picker left
beamsplit_nav_left.desc: Use BeamNG's normal recovery for this player's car, or move left while a BeamSplit menu is open.

beamsplit_nav_right.title: Picker: right
beamsplit_nav_right.desc: Move the selection right in this player's vehicle picker.

beamsplit_nav_up.title: Picker: up
beamsplit_nav_up.desc: Move the selection up a row in this player's vehicle picker.

beamsplit_nav_down.title: Picker: down
beamsplit_nav_down.desc: Move the selection down a row in this player's vehicle picker.

beamsplit_nav_back.title: Picker: close
beamsplit_nav_back.desc: Close this player's vehicle picker without changing car.

beamsplit_picker.title: Open vehicle picker (split-screen)
beamsplit_picker.desc: Open or close this player's vehicle picker while BeamSplit is active.

beamsplit_picker_confirm.title: Confirm vehicle picker (split-screen)
beamsplit_picker_confirm.desc: Open a model's presets or replace this player's car with the highlighted preset.
